description_en: Starts a disaster recovery drill in a replication pair-consistent group to ensure the continued replication and restores data from the latest recovery point of secondary disks to new disks. This helps test the completeness and correctness of applications that are deployed on the disaster recovery site on a regular basis
description_zh: 您可以通过演练切换功能确保复制流程持续运行，同时将从盘最近恢复点的数据克隆至一块新的云盘，定期验证容灾站点应用的完整性和正确性
kebab_example: aliyun ebs start-replica-group-drill --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --group-id pg-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartReplicaGroupDrill

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the secondary site in the replication pair-consistent group is located. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426614.html operation to query the region where the secondary site in the replication pair-consistent group is located.

You must enable the disaster recovery drill feature in the region in which the secondary site resides
parameters.help_zh:
异步复制组的当前从端所属地域ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426614.html接口查询异步复制组的当前从端地域。
必须在当前从端所属地域下启用容灾演练功能
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the replication pair-consistent group ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426614.html operation the most recent list of async replication pair-consistent groups, including group IDs
parameters.help_zh: 复制组ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426614.html接口查询异步复制组列表，获得复制组ID
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
